title: Leonida 55 — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker

exophase.name: Exophase
exophase.note: PS5 trophy list, as reported by Push Square

stages.name: Story first
stages.blurb: Play the campaign from Chapter 1 to the finale. Do the one possibly missable meditation in Chapter 1, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay.

stages.name: The 100% checklist
stages.blurb: After the story the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress > Stats. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and everything on it stays available in free-roam.

stages.name: Strangers & side quests
stages.blurb: Finish the stranger strands and the odd one-off trophies the checklist does not cover. Nothing here is missable; every quest giver is still around after the story.

stages.name: Crime & cleanup
stages.blurb: Partner robberies, combat feats and the last money trophies. Then the platinum pops.

audit.note: Three trophies have no confirmed unlock method yet and are labelled honestly instead of guessed.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. Nothing about it needs multiplayer or DLC, and there is no shortcut — the road runs through the story, the 100% checklist, and every side strand in this guide. Treat it as a finish line, not a task: work the stages in order and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — the first mission of the game. You cannot miss it, and there is nothing to prepare: just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when Chapter 1 ends. Before you leave the chapter, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house — it is the one thing in the whole list that may not come back (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter just in case.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when Chapter 2 ends. Chapter 2 is where the map opens up properly: once you can switch between Jason and Lucia freely, partner trophies and the stranger strands start unlocking. Save at the chapter start — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when Chapter 3 ends. This chapter unlocks several systems the later trophies need — the Key Cloner, jewelry jobs, and the stranger strands for Randy and Tyrone — so it is worth clearing the optional missions it offers as they appear rather than rushing past them.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when Chapter 4 ends. Most of the named-mission trophies in this guide sit in Chapter 4, and the optional mission that opens bank-vault robberies appears here too — take it when it shows up, since it feeds two later trophies at once.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when you finish the final mission. Before you start it, make a manual save: the game keeps free-roam open afterwards, but a save from just before the finale is cheap insurance for anything you want to redo. After the credits, the 100% checklist unlocks and Stage 2 begins.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically by finishing the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2. It is a main-mission trophy, so it cannot be missed — play the mission and it pops at the end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically by finishing The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Like every main-mission trophy it unlocks on completion and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically by finishing the Child's Play mission in Chapter 4. A main-mission trophy: finish the mission and it is yours.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically by finishing the Headliners mission in Chapter 4. Main-mission trophies cannot be missed — complete the mission and move on.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically by finishing the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4. It unlocks on mission completion; nothing extra is needed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically by finishing Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It is the last of the named-mission trophies, and it lands close to the finale — after it, only the final mission stands between you and free-roam cleanup.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the reason the platinum takes about 200 hours. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, but anything you did during the story already counts. The good news: it is lenient, closer to 60% true completion. Most side quests are not required, collectibles are only partly required — 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 70 of 80 challenges — and the only lines that demand everything are robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunts. Work through Stage 2 in this guide and the checklist fills itself in; nothing on it is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: There are 397 stunts in Leonida, split into four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps — and you only need any 250 of them, mixing kinds freely. The quickest are the under-the-bridge flights in a plane, so knock those out first and let the rest accumulate while you travel. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts; the 100% checklist wants 300, so this trophy falls on the way there.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The game tracks nine activity types — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt — and you need one of each. Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which you have done; the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks where each lives. You will almost certainly finish this by accident while chasing other trophies, so check the tracker before going out of your way.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Twelve shooting ranges host 42 challenges between them, and every one needs a gold medal. Treat each range as its own small puzzle: learn the target pattern, then run it clean rather than spraying. Raising your Focus level helps — it grows from range practice itself, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — so the medals get easier the longer you play. All 42 are also a 100% checklist line, so there is no way around them; do them in one focused block.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen drone-race spots are scattered across Leonida, hosting 42 races in total, and you need a win at every spot. Learn each course's tight corners before pushing for speed — a clean line beats a fast crash. Drone races are also a full 100% checklist line, so wins here do double duty toward A Long Road.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Forty unique race spots exist and you need wins at 20 different ones — repeats at the same spot do not count. Pick the shortest courses first and use the fastest car you own; most races are won on the opening straight and the first corner, so brake late but clean. Your wins also feed the race challenges, so this pairs naturally with One Last Thing.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot — a purple marker on the map — and his little questline begins. Follow it: the fishing challenge against him is a straight contest of reeling in the better catch, and losing just means trying again. Fishing also counts toward the activity types and the challenges, so it is never wasted time.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Four arcade cabinets — the in-game video games Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck — count here, and you need to finish all the levels of any one of them. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, so pick the one you enjoy most and play it to the end. You do not need to beat every side challenge inside the game, just reach its ending.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. It runs five quests long and ends with the final one unlocking this trophy. Nothing in it is missable — it stays available after the story — but do it as Lucia, since Jason cannot start it.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand starts in Chapter 1, after the mission where you work for him — he calls, then marks himself with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at shipwrecks: seven in total, handed over in sets, with a metal detector to dig finds off the ocean floor. He goes quiet for a stretch mid-story, then comes back — call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 if you want to hurry him along. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and is marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Five quests — mud-club jobs, a stolen car, and a hometown finale — and the trophy pops at the end of the last one. Like the other character strands it stays open after the story, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Not every side strand counts — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy are their own trophies and do not count here. The ones that do include Kirk's skunk-ape hunt, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's street-racing mentorship and Pilot Pete's delivery runs. Work the open-world strangers as you find them; the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many of the eight you have banked. One caution from the guides: Yago's race strand has a time-sensitive step, so do his race the moment it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand starts in Chapter 3, when the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS hands you the Key Cloner and a Zorrusso to deliver. After that he wants sixteen high-end sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against his wishlist before stealing one, deliver in good condition for better pay, and use Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List to see what is left. East Vice City and Ocean Beach are the richest hunting grounds.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point you at synthetic labs around Vice City — smash them up, and once enough are gone Tyrone hands you the final job, Spin On This. It all stays available after the story, so fold it into your Stage 3 sweep.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots at 10 locations across Leonida, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice — track the total under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Do the last spots only after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when both characters can be played together. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: one early meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. That session adds +1 to the counter but is not listed as a spot, so nobody has confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it — the guides disagree on that point, and this guide hedges with them. Do it anyway, and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1: it costs nothing and covers the only maybe-missable trophy in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's strand is Jason-only and starts after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks his first hunt in Lummox County. His quests ask you to hunt specific animals and bring them back; the first one hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. His hunts also feed the 15 Target Decks, which the 100% checklist wants in full — so this strand does double duty.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Eighteen collectible card sets hide across Leonida and you need any three complete. Cards turn up in the world as you explore, and a set completes when you hold every card in it — check your collection under Progress > Collections. The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so if you are chasing A Long Road you will blow past three sets without noticing.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are objects in the world — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — that you scan by holding up on the D-pad and pressing R1. There are far more than 100, so any hundred count. The habit to build: scan everything that glints while you are already out doing other trophies, especially in Vice City where landmarks cluster. It pairs perfectly with vehicle scanning for Whip It Good.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Eighty challenges exist and you need any 50; the 100% checklist wants 70, so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road. Browse them under Progress > Challenges and cherry-pick the easy ones first — racing, stunts and activities you are already doing all feed the list. Leave this for late in Stage 2, when dozens will already be ticked off without any extra effort.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need your partner beside you, so this only opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — call them with right on the D-pad plus Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone on a fast motorcycle, cutting through traffic; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the classic escape route because cops and helicopters struggle to follow on the tracks. The trophy pops once you are out of the heat zone. You will probably earn it for free while robbing bank vaults in Stage 2, since those always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, hit three robbery targets in a row — green icons on the map — while the wanted level never drops. Keep the red-and-blue flashing level alive between shops; if the cops lose you, the chain breaks. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items, and loot each shop properly, including the back-room safe. A good run is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's jewelry jobs in Chapter 3. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after the third shop, so do not panic — and if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch and you need to discover 100 of them. Scanning with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes; new models add to the database instantly. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models scanned, so this trophy arrives long before that line is done.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus — L3 + R3 while aiming — slows time and highlights weak spots, but only lasts a few seconds, so you need five quick kills in one activation. Set it up: eat or drink to top up focus, pop Adrenaline to stretch the window, wear body armor, and bring an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Gang operations are the best stage — five criminals grouped together — and it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus level matters, and it rises from range practice, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets noticeably easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the big passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — the ones on the open airfield do not count. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, board, head upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops — it is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it fires.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island base at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks sit in the south of the base, reachable through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Climb in, fire at the soldiers who respond, and the trophy pops once you have used it. Bring body armor for the approach; the hard part is getting to the tank, not driving it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3: that unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door and choose the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in — kicking trips the alarm and voids the stealth. Inside, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, and slip out unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a reliable first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank-vault robbery opens with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — you tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip (after his earlier Payday Loans jobs) and he marks more security vans in purple; follow each to its bank. Eight large bank jobs exist and the 100% checklist wants all eight, so five comes naturally. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and switch vehicles to shake the heat.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The same Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vaults covers this one: robbing a vault counts as robbing the armored truck that delivered the cash, so it pops during Maximum Withdrawal. If you want it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, blow it open and escape the red heat radius — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map. The fastest way is a plane: fly over every black-fogged region until the map is fully visible. You will clear most of it naturally by driving to missions and collectibles, so save this for the end of Stage 2 and mop up whatever fog remains in one flight.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run 39 illegal operations between them, and you need one from each gang — not all 39. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to a much longer grind.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no reliable unlock method has been published yet. The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the likely trigger is ordering a drink at a beachfront bar, but the guides list this one as still unknown. This guide will not invent a method: check the sources linked below for updates, and try the obvious beach bars in free-roam.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window — only that specific car triggers it, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS for Randy. The pop is slightly delayed, so keep driving down the street after you smash out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations — and escape the police. The three are a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the office safe, which needs sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation. You first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but you do not need all three in one go: the robbery icon respawns, so come back later for whatever you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Strength grows from working out — buy a gym membership and train — and the trick is to always train together: call your partner along, and while one of you works out the other completes their training automatically, doubling progress. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength. You can only switch characters after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, and there are gyms all over Vice City plus a home setup after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that shift your criminal profile — the game counts everything from clean stealthy robberies to full chaos. Turn on profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so you see the little demon face each time one registers. It builds passively across the whole platinum run: every robbery and fight feeds it, so do not farm it until the very end, when running over the remaining stragglers with a car closes the gap fast. One warning: pushing the profile to Irredeemable is permanent and makes cops far more aggressive.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no reliable unlock method has been published yet. The guides believe it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and the description hints at a second attempt succeeding where the first failed, but nobody has pinned down the exact trigger. This guide lists it honestly rather than guessing: watch the sources below for a confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Finish the UFO easter egg. After 2AM, drive alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside. If it is there, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO. The spawn is slightly random — if the car is not there, drive away and come back until it is. Go solo: bringing your partner seems to block it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED in detail — the description asks for a melee drive-by that bowls people over, and the guides agree the exact method is still being confirmed. The working reading is a drive-by with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, most plausibly near the bowling alley, but no source has locked it down yet. Try melee drive-bys in free-roam and check the linked sources for the confirmed method rather than following a guessed one.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults are the richest source, paying up to $205,000 per bank — and your contacts launder them into clean cash. Keep robbing and laundering as you work Stage 2 and the total climbs on its own; the vaults alone nearly cover it. Track the running total in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, ammo, armor, clothes, food, anything counts. You will get most of the way there just by gearing up for the other trophies: sticky bombs, body armor and Adrenaline add up fast. If you are short at the end, buy the most expensive weapon attachments and vehicles until the total tips over.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. They are the safehouses for your vehicle collection, and the money for them comes from the same robbery loop that funds Dime on the Dollar — bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so fund the garages from vault runs. Once the last one is bought, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — drive a vehicle you own into the app's registration flow and repeat with ten different ones. The cheapest path is to register the cars you already own from story missions and Randy deliveries rather than buying new ones. Ten registrations and it pops.
